diagnostic_evidence.quote: We have represented on \cref{fig5:convFactTE-kcomplex} the spectral radius of the iteration matrix for TE-modes (it is the same for TM-modes as previously explained) and the limiting spectrum taking $k = 10 + \imath$.

If $a \neq 0$ and $b \neq 0$, the spectral radius of $I^{\rm{T}}(i)$ satisfies: \[ \lim_{N \rightarrow +\infty} \rho(I^{\rm{T}}(i)) = \max(|a^{\rm T}_i(\kappa)+b^{\rm T}_i(\kappa)|,|a^{\rm T}_i(\kappa)-b^{\rm T}_i(\kappa)|), \quad \text{T} \in \{\text{TE}, \text{TEM}, \text{TM}\}. \]

issues.failure_explanation: The abstract claims to demonstrate wavenumber robustness, but the paper only provides numerical experiments for a single complex wavenumber k=10+i and no theorem establishing a uniform bound on the limiting spectrum as k varies. The only theoretical result (thm:spectre-limit) gives the limit for fixed parameters.

failure_location.quote: Furthermore, we demonstrate that the one-level Schwarz method can achieve robustness with respect to the wave number under specific domain decomposition parameters, offering new insights into its applicability for large-scale electromagnetic wave problems.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Either remove the wavenumber robustness claim or provide a theoretical proof that the limiting spectrum is uniformly bounded away from 1 for the specified parameters as the wavenumber varies.
issues.overall_effect: The advertised contribution of wavenumber robustness is not supported by the formal results or numerical evidence.
issues.title: Unsupported claim of wavenumber robustness
issues.why_classification: The claim is a main contribution; removing it loses an advertised result, and proving it would require a new nontrivial argument. It is not a minor local fix.

issues.failure_explanation: The eigenvalue problem defines -Δφ = λ φ, so separation of variables gives β^2 = k^2 - λ. The paper instead defines β = sqrt(k^2 - λ^2). This is inconsistent; either eq:ev should have λ^2 or the β definition should not square λ. The same issue occurs for TM modes.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Change the β definitions to sqrt(k^2 - λ) or change the eigenvalue problems to -Δφ = λ^2 φ and adjust the profile formulas accordingly.
issues.overall_effect: The propagation constants for TE/TM modes are incorrect as defined, affecting the modal decomposition.
issues.title: Inconsistent relation between propagation constant and eigenvalue
issues.why_classification: A local notational fix (adding or removing a square) restores consistency; the DDM analysis treats β as a parameter and is unaffected.

issues.failure_explanation: The Maxwell system does not include a conductivity term σ, and σ is not defined before its appearance in eq:syst-recov. The equations are ill-defined unless σ=0.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Set σ=0 in eq:syst-recov and in the subsequent proof.
issues.overall_effect: The derivation of mode profiles and the proof of prop:BC-TE-TM use these equations and are not rigorous as written.
issues.title: Undefined conductivity parameter σ in recovery equations
issues.why_classification: A local correction (setting σ=0) fixes the equations without changing the results.

issues.failure_explanation: The PML solution has x-dependence e^{iβ(1+iσ)(x-b_j)}. Differentiating with respect to x produces a factor iβ(1+iσ). The displayed operator omits (1+iσ). The final T formula is correct, indicating the intermediate equation is inconsistent.

failure_location.quote: ((\nabla \times \bfE) \times \mathbf{n}) \times \mathbf{n} = & \sum_{i \in \N^+} A^{\rm TE,+}_i \imath \beta^{\rm TE}_i \left( 1 + e^{2 \imath \beta^{\rm TE}_i (1+ \imath \sigma)\ell} \right) \widehat{\bfE}^{\rm TE,+}_i \times \mathbf{n}

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Include the missing (1+iσ) factor in def:op-PML or clarify the derivation to avoid the inconsistent intermediate step.
issues.overall_effect: The derivation of the PML transmission condition is not rigorous as written, although the final λ formula is correct.
issues.title: Missing stretching factor in PML operator equation
issues.why_classification: A local algebraic correction; the final transmission condition and main results are unaffected.

issues.failure_explanation: The identity has an extra minus sign. LHS = k^2(β^2 - k^2)/β^2, while RHS = -k^2(β^2 - k^2)/β^2. The correct identity is without the minus sign.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Remove the minus sign from the identity.
issues.overall_effect: The algebraic justification for comparing TE and TM iteration matrices is flawed, though the conclusion may still hold.
issues.title: Incorrect algebraic identity in TE-TM comparison
issues.why_classification: A local sign correction in a remark; the main spectral comparison remains valid.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: for $\sigma > 0$ and $\ell = +\infty$, the PML will tend to a transparent boundary condition and $\lambda_i^{\rm TE} = -\beta^{\rm TE}_i$

issues.failure_explanation: The transparent boundary condition gives λ = -iβ = -κ, not λ = κ. Although a=0 still holds because λ^2=κ^2, substituting λ=-κ into the formula for b gives b = e^{iβ(L+δ)}, not e^{-iβ(L+δ)}. The nilpotency claim is unaffected.

failure_location.quote: we have $\lambda^{\rm T}_i = \kappa$ and therefore $a^{\rm T}_i = 0$ and $b^{\rm T}_i = e^{-\imath \beta^{\rm T}_i (L+\delta)}$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct the statement to λ = -κ and b = e^{iβ(L+δ)}.
issues.overall_effect: The explicit formulas for λ and b in the infinite PML case are wrong, but the main nilpotency result remains valid.
issues.title: Incorrect λ and b formulas for infinite PML
issues.why_classification: A local sign correction; the central nilpotency claim and its proof are correct.
